points.point: how to make music play on the TikTok picture slideshow sent from n8n
points.sentence: Add autoAddMusic: true parameter in PUBLISH TO TIKTOK step for music.

points.point: the music applies to a picture slideshow (photo post) on TikTok
points.sentence: Add music to photo posts. No effect on videos.

verdict.reason: The entry tells the customer to set autoAddMusic: true in the TikTok publish step, and states that this adds music to photo posts, which matches a TikTok picture slideshow sent through the API.
